mainTopic: Which disqualified items are not taken down once they have gone up on the מזבח: the end of רבי שמעון's derivation, and רבי יהודה's separate source for לן and יוצא
overview: Our משנה lists disqualified items that are not taken down once they have gone up on the מזבח, such as something left overnight (לן) or something that left its area (יוצא). The גמרא first finishes רבי שמעון's derivation. The פסוק both includes and excludes, so he includes items whose disqualification happened within the holy service and excludes the rest. Next the גמרא brings a ברייתא for רבי יהודה, who does not use that test. It explains each item by comparison: לן from אימורין and meat, יוצא from a במה, טמא and פסולין from communal offerings, חוץ לזמנו from פיגול, and חוץ למקומו by a היקש to חוץ לזמנו. The גמרא challenges this, because you cannot learn a disqualified case from a fully kosher one. It answers that the real source is the פסוק 'זאת תורת העולה', which includes many cases, and that the comparisons are only supports. Finally רבי יוחנן rules that one who slaughters a קרבן at night inside the עזרה and offers it up outside is חייב. His reasoning continues on the next amud.

steps.title: רבי שמעון's rule: include disqualifications that happened in holiness
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא finishes רבי שמעון's derivation. The פסוק both includes and excludes, so he includes items whose problem arose within the holy service and excludes items whose problem did not.
steps.simpleTranslation: [The verse included] and the verse excluded. I include those whose disqualification happened in holiness, and I exclude those whose disqualification did not happen in holiness.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is finishing רבי שמעון's explanation of how the פסוק tells us which disqualified items stay on the מזבח once they go up.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since the פסוק both includes (ריבה) and excludes (מיעט), we need a way to split the cases. רבי שמעון splits them like this: if the problem arose within the holy process (פסולו בקודש), the item stays on the מזבח. If the problem was not of that kind, it comes down.

keyTerms.meaning: The פסוק included and then excluded, so some cases are in and some are out
I include (in the rule that it stays up)
Their disqualification
In holiness, meaning the problem arose within the holy service itself

steps.whyThisMatters: This principle is רבי שמעון's key test for the whole משנה. It is exactly the principle רבי יהודה does not use, which is why the next step has to find him a different source.

phrases.english: and the verse excluded,
I include those
phrases.notes: Include them in the rule that once they went up, they don't come down.

phrases.english: whose disqualification was in holiness,
and I exclude those
whose disqualification was not in holiness.

steps.triggerLanguage: מְרַבֶּה אֲנִי אֶת אֵלּוּ שֶׁהָיָה פְּסוּלָן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes רבי שמעון's derivation from the פסוק, which began before this part of the daf.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Items whose disqualification arose within the holy service do not come down from the מזבח. Items whose disqualification did not arise that way do come down.

steps.title: רבי יהודה's source for blood left overnight
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה learns the rule for לן from a ברייתא. Blood left overnight is fit because left-overnight אימורין are fit, and those are fit because left-overnight meat is fit.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבי יהודה brings it from here: Why did they say that blood left overnight is fit? Because leaving overnight is fit for the אימורין. And why is leaving overnight fit for the אימורין? Because leaving overnight is fit for the meat.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows that רבי יהודה does not use רבי שמעון's principle. Instead he learns from a ברייתא why something left overnight (לן) stays on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא builds a chain of comparisons. Blood left overnight is compared to אימורין left overnight, and those are compared to meat, which is allowed to stay overnight. Since being 'left overnight' is acceptable in some parts of a קרבן, it is not a strong enough problem to force the item down from the מזבח.

keyTerms.meaning: He brings (learns) it from here
Left overnight past its proper time
The fat parts of a קרבן that are burned on the מזבח
Fit, acceptable (here: it stays on the מזבח)

steps.confusionAlert: כשר here does not mean the קרבן is fine from the start. It means that if it already went up on the מזבח, it is not taken down.

phrases.english: And Rabbi Yehuda derives it from here:
For what reason did they say
that left overnight is fit in the case of blood?
Because left overnight is fit in the case of sacrificial portions.
And why is left overnight fit for sacrificial portions?
Because left overnight is fit in the case of meat.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives רבי יהודה a separate source, since he does not accept רבי שמעון's principle about disqualification in holiness.
steps.raayaObject: That blood and אימורין left overnight stay on the מזבח once they have gone up, according to רבי יהודה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא that compares, step by step, blood to אימורין and אימורין to meat.

steps.title: Source for an item that left its area
steps.stepSummary: The same ברייתא explains why יוצא stays on the מזבח: leaving the area is acceptable for a קרבן offered on a במה.
steps.simpleTranslation: An item that went out is fit, because going out is fit in the case of a private altar (במה).
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא continues and gives the source for יוצא, a קרבן that went outside its permitted area.
steps.deeperAnalysis: On a private altar (במה) there is no fixed holy area to leave, so 'going out' is not a problem there at all. Since this problem doesn't disqualify everywhere, it is not strong enough to take the item down once it went up on the מזבח.

keyTerms.meaning: A קרבן that left its permitted area
A private altar, allowed at certain times in history

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יהודה does not use רבי שמעון's 'disqualified in holiness' test. The ברייתא he relies on gives a comparison for each item, starting with לן (from אימורין and meat) and יוצא (from a במה). Step 9 shows that these comparisons are only supports for a פסוק.

phrases.english: An item that went out [is fit]
phrases.notes: Short for: and why is something that went out fit if it was already put on the מזבח?

phrases.english: since going out is fit on a private altar.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the same ברייתא, moving from לן to יוצא.
steps.raayaObject: That יוצא stays on the מזבח once it has gone up, according to רבי יהודה.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The fact that leaving the area does not disqualify a קרבן offered on a במה.

steps.title: An impure offering stays because impurity is allowed for communal offerings
steps.stepSummary: A טמא קרבן that went up on the מזבח does not come down. This is because impurity is permitted for עבודת ציבור.
steps.simpleTranslation: An impure offering: since impurity was permitted for communal service.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא moves to the next item in the משנה's list, a טמא קרבן. It explains why this קרבן stays on the מזבח once it has gone up.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Communal offerings may sometimes be brought even when they are impure. So impurity is not a total block to a קרבן being offered. That is enough for an impure קרבן to stay on the מזבח once it is already up there.

keyTerms.meaning: ritually impure
since, because
communal service, offerings brought on behalf of the whole community

phrases.english: An impure offering [that went up does not come down]
since it was permitted for communal service.
phrases.notes: When the community is impure, communal קרבנות can still be brought, so impurity doesn't fully block a קרבן.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the same ברייתא, moving from יוצא to טמא.
steps.raayaObject: That a טמא קרבן stays on the מזבח once it has gone up.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The rule that impurity is permitted for עבודת ציבור.

steps.title: A פיגול offering stays because it still works enough to become פיגול
steps.stepSummary: A קרבן slaughtered with intent for חוץ לזמנו stays on the מזבח. This is because its service still 'works' in the sense that it makes the קרבן פיגול.
steps.simpleTranslation: Slaughtered with intent for beyond its time: since it is effective in making it פיגול.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא explains why a קרבן slaughtered with a wrong intention about time, which makes it פיגול, is not taken down from the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: פיגול only takes effect when the rest of the service was done properly, like a valid קרבן. So the service of a פיגול offering still 'counts' in a way. That shows it still has the standing of a קרבן, so it stays on the מזבח.

keyTerms.meaning: beyond its time; intent to eat or burn the קרבן after its allowed time
is effective, works (said of the service)
a קרבן disqualified by the wrong intention about time

steps.confusionAlert: 'מרצה' here does not mean the קרבן is accepted for good. It only means the service works enough to give the קרבן the status of פיגול.

phrases.english: [One slaughtered with intent for] beyond its time
since it is effective in making it פיגול.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Next item in the same list of reasons.
steps.raayaObject: That a חוץ לזמנו קרבן stays on the מזבח.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The fact that its service still works to create פיגול.

steps.title: Outside its place is compared to beyond its time
steps.stepSummary: A קרבן slaughtered with intent for חוץ למקומו stays on the מזבח, because it is linked by a היקש to חוץ לזמנו.
steps.simpleTranslation: Slaughtered with intent for outside its place: since it is compared to beyond its time.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא explains why a קרבן slaughtered with a wrong intention about place also stays on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Wrong intention about place does not create פיגול, so the last reason does not fit here directly. Instead, the ברייתא uses a היקש, a comparison that links the two. Whatever is true of חוץ לזמנו here is true of חוץ למקומו too.

keyTerms.meaning: outside its place; intent to eat or burn the קרבן outside its allowed area
it is compared, linked by a היקש

phrases.english: [One slaughtered with intent for] outside its place
since it is compared to beyond its time.

steps.triggerLanguage: חוּץ לִמְקוֹמוֹ – הוֹאִיל וְאִיתַּקַּשׁ לְחוּץ לִזְמַנּוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Builds directly on step 5: חוץ למקומו borrows the result of חוץ לזמנו.
steps.raayaObject: That a חוץ למקומו קרבן stays on the מזבח.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The היקש comparing חוץ למקומו to חוץ לזמנו.

steps.title: Blood handled by unfit people stays because impure priests may serve communal offerings
steps.stepSummary: If פסולין received and sprinkled the blood, the קרבן stays on the מזבח. This is because some of those פסולין, impure כהנים, are fit for עבודת ציבור.
steps.simpleTranslation: That unfit people received and sprinkled its blood: from those unfit ones who are fit for communal service.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא gives the reason for the last item in the משנה's list, a קרבן whose blood was handled by people unfit to serve.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Some disqualified people, such as impure כהנים, are allowed to serve when communal offerings are brought in impurity. Since these פסולין can sometimes do the service, a קרבן handled by פסולין is not totally invalid. So it stays on the מזבח.

keyTerms.meaning: people unfit to do the Temple service
they sprinkled (the blood on the מזבח)
are fit

steps.whatToRemember: In רבי יהודה's ברייתא, each disqualified item is linked to a case where that same problem is allowed or still works: לן through meat, יוצא through a במה, טמא and פסולין through communal service, חוץ לזמנו through פיגול, and חוץ למקומו through a היקש to חוץ לזמנו. As steps 8-9 show, these links are only supports. The real source is the פסוק.

phrases.english: [One] whose blood unfit people received and sprinkled
[is learned] from those unfit ones who are fit for communal service.
phrases.notes: 'Those unfit ones' means impure כהנים, who may serve when communal קרבנות are brought in impurity.

steps.triggerLanguage: שֶׁקִּבְּלוּ פְּסוּלִין וְזָרְקוּ אֶת דָּמוֹ – בְּהָנָךְ פְּסוּלֵי דַּחֲזוֹ לַעֲבוֹדַת צִיבּוּר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Final item of the list. It uses the same communal-service idea as step 4.
steps.raayaObject: That a קרבן whose blood was handled by פסולין stays on the מזבח.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The rule that impure כהנים are fit for עבודת ציבור.

steps.title: Can a disqualified case be learned from a kosher case?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא attacks the ברייתא's reasoning. It compared disqualified offerings to kosher situations, and you cannot learn a פסול from something that is fully fit.
steps.simpleTranslation: But can we learn about something that is not in its fit state from something that is in its fit state?!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges the reasons the ברייתא gave for why certain פסולין stay on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא learned that אימורין left overnight (לן) stay up because the meat of שלמים may be eaten over two days and the night between. It also learned that an offering that left the עזרה (יוצא) stays up because of a במה. But meat still within its eating time and a במה are completely kosher situations. A kosher case cannot prove that a disqualified offering should be treated well.

keyTerms.meaning: We learn or derive one law from another
Not in its fit, kosher state; disqualified
In its fit, kosher state

steps.confusionAlert: The גמרא is not saying that the הלכות of לן and יוצא are wrong. It only questions the reasons the ברייתא gave for them.

phrases.english: But can we derive a matter
that is not in its fit state,
from a matter that is in its fit state?!
phrases.notes: He means שלמים that may still be eaten, and a kosher במה. Both are completely fit situations.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְכִי דָּנִין דָּבָר שֶׁלֹּא בְּהֶכְשֵׁרוֹ, מִדָּבָר שֶׁבְּהֶכְשֵׁרוֹ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the reasoning used in the ברייתא for לן and יוצא
steps.kashyaTarget: The ברייתא's comparison of לן to שלמים and of יוצא to a במה
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A disqualified offering cannot be derived from a case that is fully kosher, because the kosher case has no disqualification at all.

steps.title: The real source is the inclusive פסוק 'זאת תורת העולה'
steps.stepSummary: The תנא actually relied on the פסוק 'זאת תורת העולה', which includes many types of פסולין. The reasons in the ברייתא were only supports.
steps.simpleTranslation: The תנא relied on 'This is the law of the burnt offering,' which includes many cases.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge. The real source is a פסוק, not the comparisons.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The words 'זאת תורת העולה' teach a broad rule (ריבה) that many disqualified offerings stay on the מזבח once they went up. The comparisons in the ברייתא were never the true proof. They only explain why רבי יהודה did not exclude these cases with his limiting words.

keyTerms.meaning: 'This is the law of the burnt offering' (ויקרא 6:2)
It included, widened the law to cover more cases
He relied on it

steps.whatToRemember: The real source for פסולין staying on the מזבח is the inclusive פסוק 'זאת תורת העולה'. The reasons in the ברייתא only support it.

phrases.english: The תנא, on 'This is the law of the burnt offering,'
which included more cases, relied on it.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּנָּא אַ״זֹּאת תּוֹרַת הָעֹלָה״ רִיבָּה סְמִיךְ לֵיהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the קשיא by moving the source from comparisons to a פסוק
steps.terutzResolutionType: Relocating the source: the comparisons are only supports, and the פסוק is the real source
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא's comparisons were the actual proof, so they were open to attack
steps.terutzMaskana: The law comes from the inclusive פסוק 'זאת תורת העולה'; the comparisons only support it

steps.title: Slaughtered at night inside, offered up outside: he is liable
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן rules that someone who slaughters a קרבן at night inside the עזרה and then offers it up outside is חייב for offering outside.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said: One who slaughters an animal at night inside the עזרה and offers it up outside is liable.
steps.whatsHappening: A new topic begins. רבי יוחנן gives a ruling about a קרבן slaughtered at night, which is a פסול, that was then offered up outside the עזרה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Usually a person is liable for offering outside (העלאה בחוץ) only if the offering would have been accepted on the מזבח inside. Slaughter at night is a פסול, yet רבי יוחנן still says he is חייב. The reason for this ruling comes in the continuation of the גמרא.

keyTerms.meaning: Inside the עזרה (Temple courtyard)
Offered it up on an altar outside the עזרה
Liable; here, to the punishment for offering outside

steps.whyThisMatters: This connects the earlier discussion of which פסולין stay on the מזבח to the separate law of offering a קרבן outside the עזרה.

phrases.english: רבי יוחנן said:
One who slaughters an animal at night inside
and offered it up outside is liable,

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: הַשּׁוֹחֵט בְּהֵמָה בַּלַּיְלָה בִּפְנִים וְהֶעֱלָה בַּחוּץ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new topic linked to the משנה's case of a קרבן slaughtered at night, which רבי יהודה says comes down from the מזבח.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Slaughtering at night inside and offering up outside makes one חייב for offering outside
